calls.title: NICE Stock Analysis: Buy or Sell?
calls.thesis: Revenue accelerating (7.7% 2025 to 11.8% 2028), AI bookings and backlog growing; stock looks undervalued on forward P/E and DCF
calls.conviction: low - margin stabilization not yet seen
calls.base: Revenue $1B to $3B+ over decade, headed to ~$3.9B by 2028
calls.bull: Margins stabilize/inflect higher with revenue scale
calls.bear: CFO-to-sales keeps slipping; ROIC 10.8% below WACC
